userClarification.detail: The missing CLI entry error appeared while testing the attempted fix for repeated runtime-image extraction and app-data growth on each app open.

confirmedSourceRegression.commitTitle: fix(android): reuse web runtime image and persist workspace
confirmedSourceRegression.beforeChange: ProfileImage.install returned the extracted root directory at staging/tree; OriginalWebRuntimeService resolved runtime/lib/bin.js relative to that root.
confirmedSourceRegression.regression: The stable-cache change created root=staging/tree, wrote the archive marker inside root, then renamed staging to profile-image-current and returned that parent. The actual entry therefore landed at profile-image-current/tree/runtime/lib/bin.js, but both the cache-hit predicate and OriginalWebRuntimeService expected profile-image-current/runtime/lib/bin.js.
effects: The CLI entry check reports Packaged production dsh CLI entry unavailable even though the APK image archive contains the entry.
The cache-hit predicate cannot see the marker or CLI entry at the expected stable-root paths, so it misses and re-extracts the image on subsequent opens instead of reusing it.
supportingEvidence: The source diff from Android CI run 44506017022 shows staging.renameTo(current) followed by return current while extracted files and marker are under root=staging/tree.
The exact APK from Android CI run 44508078912 contains runtime/lib/bin.js in assets/runtime/profile-image.zip with a matching manifest hash.

localCorrection.implementation: Move the extracted root directory itself to profile-image-current; remove the now-empty staging parent best-effort.
localCorrection.regressionTest: apps/android/app/src/test/java/io/github/mohammedteir/deepseekharness/ProfileImagePublicationTest.kt checks that profile-image-current/runtime/lib/bin.js and the cache marker exist directly, with no extra tree/ segment.
